An '''Infiltrator''' was a type of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] used by members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] around [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Relin Druur]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Drev Hassin]], flew one during an [[Skirmish over Phaegon III|attack]] on the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire's]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] forces on a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Phaegon III]].<ref name="Cross" />
